name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Add a 4-pixel solid focus ring in the brand color on every interactive element that receives keyboard focus. This ensures keyboard users can see where they are without relying on color alone, meeting WCAG 2.2 SC 2.4.11 Focus Not Obscured (Minimum). The trade-off is a slight visual increase in element size, but it’s necessary for clarity and compliance.

name: Reader
text: Risk: A 4-pixel ring risks blending into low-contrast backgrounds or small touch targets on mobile, failing WCAG 2.1 SC 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum). Better: Use a 3px solid ring with a 3px outer glow in the brand color—glow ensures visibility against any background, meets reduced-motion needs via subtle animation, and scales on touch. Settle by testing on low-contrast backgrounds and mobile viewports with real users.
